title: SecretManagerSafeConfig
description: Metadata-only secret reference configuration. MUST NOT contain credential values, local paths, or provider operation fields.

secret_reference_id.description: Opaque reference ID only. Never the credential value itself.

storage_candidate.description: Selected storage backend. Plaintext is never an allowed value.

custody_owner.description: Human owner of this secret. Must not be 'AI', 'Codex', or 'AIDEN'.

approval_reference.description: Links to the human approval record for this secret registration

incident_blocker.description: Whether an open incident blocks operations on this secret

rotation_schedule_days.description: Optional: rotation frequency in days. Enforced by SOP, not runtime.

notes.description: Human-readable notes. Forbidden: credential values, tokens, paths, passwords.
